Stox.com is a platform for trading tokenized financial assets built on blockchain smart contracts.

Ideamarket.io is a market for ideas in which users buy and sell shares in ideas using tokens recorded on a public blockchain. Ideamarket.io operates through smart contracts rather than a central intermediary.

RealT is a platform that tokenizes rental real estate so that investors can hold fractional ownership through blockchain tokens. RealT distributes rental income to token holders.

DEX.AG is a decentralized exchange aggregator that routes trades across multiple decentralized exchanges to find favorable prices. DEX.AG executes swaps through smart contracts without a central intermediary.

BAT (Basic Attention Token) is an ERC-20 token on the Ethereum public blockchain. BAT is used within the Brave browser to reward users for attention and to compensate publishers for it.
